description: AI-driven automation is causing a structural decline in labor's share of GDP.

instances.assertion: AI-driven automation is causing a structural decline in labor's share of GDP.
AI-driven automation is rendering the traditional social contract—where hard work and education lead to middle-class stability—obsolete.
AI-driven automation could displace half of all entry-level white-collar jobs within the next 1-5 years.
AI-driven automation can lead to significant job displacement in sectors like journalism and the arts.
